messages.subject: reroot() function for several trees in one session fails
messages.subject_clean: reroot() function for several trees in one session fails
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I am having trouble in rerooting several trees that I want to plot side by side.  I am using RAxML output files. The first time the function reroot() is called, everything works fine, but the second time it throws an error. I have tried it with two different data sets in order to make sure that it's not a problem with the data itself. Here is the code and the error message:

>library(ggtree)
>library(ape)
>gene1<-read.raxml("RAxML_bipartitionsBranchLabels.gene1")
>gene2<-read.raxml("RAxML_bipartitionsBranchLabels.gene2")
>g1_rooted<-reroot(gene1, node=2)
Loading required package: phytools
Loading required package: maps

Attaching package: ‘phytools’

The following object is masked from ‘package:ggtree’:

    reroot

### the tree for g1_rooted is fine ###

>g2_rooted<-reroot(gene2, node=2)
Error in reroot(gene2, node = 2) :
  tree should be an object of class "phylo".

Do you have any idea how to solve this issue?  I have read that there were some issues with support values when rerooting. Is that problem solved and are the support values drawn correctly?

Kind regards,
Marco

messages.subject: Custom labeling for gheatmap
messages.body_plain:
Hi there,

I'm trying to find a way of displaying custom labels for matrix columns supplied with gheatmap function.

To modify the vignette example:

> beast_file <- system.file("examples/MCC_FluA_H3.tree", package="ggtree")
> beast_tree <- read.beast(beast_file)
> genotype_file <- system.file("examples/Genotype.txt", package="ggtree")
> genotype <- read.table(genotype_file, sep="\t", stringsAsFactor=F)
> colnames(genotype) <- sub("\\.$", "", colnames(genotype))
> p <- ggtree(beast_tree, mrsd="2013-01-01") + geom_treescale(x=2008, y=1, offset=2)
> p <- p + geom_tiplab(size=2)

Now, I want to only display names of "PB1" and "PB2" genes and change them into "bla1" and "bla2", respectively. I've tried

> gheatmap(p, genotype, offset = 5, width=0.5, font.size=3, colnames_angle=-45, hjust=0, colnames=T) +
>   scale_x_discrete(breaks=c("PB1", "PB2"), labels=c("bla1", "bla2"))

But it doesn't seem to work. Any suggestions?

Thanks,
Rafal
